limits: Inactive probes must not be added to the existing task by editing inventory or resetting budget.
An aggregate assertion detected by one mutation does not prove each subclause is independently sensitive.
If a future candidate uses multiple assertion IDs per case, each probe must target one ID while all non-target cases pass; do not reuse the all-errors plan blindly.
DOM is a hand-built controlled subset based on component declarations and r4 locator contract, not a full PMS deployment clone or product result.

P0 uses any visible non-default department input without a label/id oracle. Independent mapping is required only for inactive004. Page2 is not a P0 precondition; non-first-page to first-page transition remains uncovered. Source freshness, account/role and actual DOM remain runtime preconditions.
